summary: NVIDIA libraries a LocalSR CUDA package may contain, with the license basis for each. Anything NVIDIA-named that is not matched here fails the build. Reviewed 2026-09-15 against the license texts shipped in the pinned nvidia-*-cu12 wheels, and on 2026-09-18 against NVIDIA's current terms: the CUDA Toolkit EULA (https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/eula/index.html, updated 2026-09-13), whose Attachment A now lists cuFile and nvJPEG and covers file names with embedded version information, the cuDNN supplement (updated 2026-09-02), and NVSHMEM's Apache-2.0 release. Copies renamed with an 8-hex-digit hash by auditwheel (torchvision.libs) are the same files.
notice_required: Distributable NVIDIA SDK portions may only be accessed by LocalSR, must stay in object form, must not be distributed stand-alone, and LocalSR's distribution terms must be consistent with NVIDIA's license restrictions.

allowed.basis: CUDA Toolkit EULA Attachment A / Apache-2.0 headers
cuDNN supplement, section 2 (docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/cudnn/latest/reference/eula.html, updated 2026-09-02): "the runtime files .so and .dll" are distributable
cuSPARSELt supplement: runtime .so files are distributable
CUDA Toolkit EULA Attachment A (updated 2026-09-13): NVIDIA CUDA File IO Libraries, libcufile.so and libcufile_rdma.so
CUDA Toolkit EULA Attachment A: NVIDIA JPEG Library, libnvjpeg.so and nvjpeg.dll
Apache-2.0: NVSHMEM v3.4.5 is published under Apache-2.0 at https://github.com/NVIDIA/nvshmem (tag v3.4.5-0)

forbidden.reason: Driver libraries are provided by the user's installed driver and are never bundled.
